en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: Adds a quick settings entry, adjustable short sessions, an estimated total preview and clearer progress and recovery states. Please check the new editor, connection changes and background use.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 新增快捷设置入口、可调短时操作和预计总量预览，并改进运行进度及异常恢复状态。请检查新调整页面、连接变化及后台使用表现。
